verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a compliance-management SaaS with an API, so letting users schedule recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no user-definable recurring scheduler. Automatic annual-report filing as reports come due is a vendor-run service, and customizable reminders are notifications. Both are adjacent features rather than user-scheduled recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
